name: file-tree
title: File Tree
description: A compact panel listing folders and files with small icons and stepped indentation. Clicking a folder unfolds it to show its contents, and clicking any row highlights it as selected.
use: Browsing a nested hierarchy such as project files or docs sections inside a bounded panel.
avoid: Flat lists, or deep trees on narrow screens where indentation crowds out the names.
a11y: Rows behave as flat buttons in an accordion, so no tree role, level or expanded state is announced. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A rounded dark card holds rows of pale grey names, each led by a small line-drawn folder or document icon. Children sit indented beneath their folder, joined by a thin vertical rule, and the active row gets a slightly lighter rounded backing.
behaves: Pressing a folder name slides it open or shut, exposing or hiding the rows underneath. Pressing a file marks that row selected; the tree keeps its own open and selected state until changed again.
customise: Pass an elements array of ids, names and children; initial selection, initially open folders, open and close icons, sorting and direction are props.
weight: light: A handful of rows animated by CSS height keyframes; nothing runs in the background.
